final: WITH team_rates AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * w / g) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_team_avg FROM team_rates) SELECT team_id, avg_win_rate, record_count, avg_win_rate - mean_team_avg AS difference FROM team_rates CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
